title: Afternoon Sunwatch
text:
☀️ Afternoon Sunwatch — October 10, 2026

🔆️ Solar activity: Moderate (C1.6)
🔥 Latest solar flare: C4.8 (Peaked October 10, 2026 at 17:52 UTC)
🔥 Strongest recent flare: M6.4 (Peaked October 10, 2026 at 15:10 UTC)
💨 Solar wind speed: 732 km/s (Intense)
🌎 Geomagnetic activity: G3 Strong Storm (Kp 7.00)
🚨 NOAA Alert: Geomagnetic K-index of 6

Earth is feeling it! Space weather is feeling a little breezy today. 🌎🌀🌌😨

Bright active regions and broad darker coronal structures are visible today, while the coronagraph shows no clearly identifiable large CME.

Image: NOAA GOES-19 SUVI — 094 Å
Data: NOAA Space Weather Prediction Center
